title: Demystifying Python Decorators & Higher-Order Functions
subtitle: How wrapping functions dynamically transforms modern backend architectures
body: Python decorators offer a clean, expressive syntax for modifying and enhancing function behaviors without altering their core source code. From Flask route registrations to caching, logging, and security authorization guards, understanding closures and *args/**kwargs unlocks production-grade software craftsmanship.
author: Tirth Patel

title: Scaling Browser Automation with Selenium & Headless Chrome
subtitle: Best practices for anti-detection, explicit waits, and exception resilience
body: Building reliable web scrapers requires handling dynamic JavaScript SPAs, shadow DOMs, and anti-bot rate limits. By tuning WebDriver options, randomizing keystroke intervals, and utilizing expected conditions over hardcoded sleeps, automated scrapers can achieve 99.9% pipeline uptime.
author: Tirth Patel

title: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) in Flask with Jinja2 Templating
subtitle: Fast, SEO-friendly web applications without frontend framework bloat
body: While single-page applications dominate modern headlines, server-side rendered pages with Jinja2 remain unmatched for blazing fast initial loads, exceptional SEO discoverability, and zero build-step simplicity. Dive into control loops, filter pipes, and template inheritance.
author: Tirth Patel
